liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **New Speedway Boogie** (6 reviews): Famous bust-out; at the time it seemed a comment on the Gulf War; Reviewer found it wonderful to hear this song again [6][7][8][9][10][14]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): China Cat into Rider and Crazy Fingers stand out for second-set jamming; The China, Rider, Truckin', Crazy Fingers, Jam sequence was outstanding [6][13]
- **Black Peter** (2 reviews): Black Peter is invigorating, a late-era highlight; Black Peter had incredible soul [8][14]
- **Bertha** (1 review): The opening Bertha is strong [7]
- **Althea** (1 review): Althea contained an unusual jam [15]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Sugar Magnolia was rollicking; the reviewer felt they floated above the crowd [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **New Speedway Boogie**: back after 1457 archived shows (7457 days) [18]
- **crowd fade**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]
- **crowd fade out**: back after 229 archived shows (1059 days); rare: 3 archived performances [18]

## The recordings

- **gd91-02-19.sbd.ladner.8574.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 195 min; rated 3.71/5 by 14 [1]. Said about its sound: Vince's keyboards sit high in the mix, though the energy still comes through; The download is very clear, and the board is good; Vince's keys are mixed far too high, often covering Jerry's guitar [6][7][8][9][10]
- **gd1991-02-19.132350.aud.mattes.petty.flac16**: audience recording; 21 songs; 182 min; rated 2.25/5 by 4 [2]
- **gd1991-02-19.141849.sbd.cm.miller.fixed.flac1644**: soundboard; 20 songs; 181 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1991-02-19.141847.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 19 songs; 174 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended, with great seats, good sightlines and good sound; energy was extremely high [13]
- The upper bowl was completely empty, the emptiest the reviewer had seen the venue [15]
- Reviewer says the band never played New Speedway this well again; later Garcia held back [10]
- February shows are usually below par, but this one is an exception [13]
- First Bay Area shows with only Vince on keyboards [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd91-02-19.sbd.ladner.8574.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > DAT > Soundforge> CDR > WAV > SHN [1]. Also: Soundboard to DAT, then Soundforge, CDR, WAV and SHN; transferred by neolevo, with Charlie Miller credited [1]
- **gd1991-02-19.132350.aud.mattes.petty.flac16**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Willl Petty; source: FOB/Schoeps CMC 34's> Oade p/s> M-1000 cables> SV-255 by Ted Mattes. DAT clone provided by Lance Deal; [2]
- **gd1991-02-19.141849.sbd.cm.miller.fixed.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [3]
- **gd1991-02-19.141847.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [4]
